description: Saturn IDE defaults: the Saturn theme, a Cursor-style layout, Tab completion, inline edit (Cmd+I), and the Saturn Agent panel backed by the local Saturn runtime.
configuration.title: Saturn
saturn.runtimeUrl: Address of the local Saturn runtime the Agent panel talks to.
saturn.completions.enabled: Suggest code as you type (Tab to accept), served by the completion model chosen in Saturn Settings → General.
saturn.codebase.enabled: Search the open folder for code related to each Agent panel message (ripgrep and workspace symbols) and include the best matches. Nothing leaves this machine except to your agent.
saturn.codebase.index: Keep a semantic index of the project (built by the Saturn runtime with its built-in embedding model by default; LM Studio or an OpenAI-compatible service can be chosen in Saturn Settings), so codebase search also finds code by meaning. Everything stays on this machine.
saturn.nextEdit.enabled: After you change a line, suggest the next related edit nearby (press Tab to apply). Uses the completion model.
saturn.commitMessage.instructions: Extra guidance for **Generate Commit Message** in the Source Control view, e.g. `Use Conventional Commits` or `Write in Traditional Chinese`. Without it, Saturn follows the style of the repository's recent commits.
saturn.agentTerminal.enabled: Mirror the commands agents run, with their output, into the read-only "Saturn Agent" terminal.
saturn.verify.auto: After an agent changes files, check the changed files for new errors and, if there are any, ask the agent to fix them (at most two rounds).
saturn.verify.command: A command that also has to pass after an agent's changes, run in the project folder (for example `npm run typecheck`). `auto` uses the project's `typecheck` or `lint` script from package.json; empty runs only the editor's own error check.
walkthrough.title: Get Started with Saturn IDE
walkthrough.description: Agents, inline edits and Tab completion, all running through the Saturn app on this computer.
walkthrough.connect.title: Connect to Saturn
walkthrough.connect.description:
Saturn IDE uses the models, keys and agents you set up in the Saturn app.
[Open Saturn Settings](command:saturn.openAppSettings)
walkthrough.chat.title: Chat with an agent (⌘L)
walkthrough.chat.description:
Ask questions, change code across files, attach context with @, or paste a screenshot.
[Open the chat](command:saturn.focusAgent)
walkthrough.inline.title: Edit in place (⌘I)
walkthrough.inline.description:
Select code and describe the change; review it as an inline diff.
[Try ⌘I](command:saturn.inlineEdit)
walkthrough.tab.title: Turn on Tab completion
walkthrough.tab.description:
Pick a completion model in Saturn Settings → General.
[Choose the completion model](command:saturn.openAppSettings)
walkthrough.index.title: Find code by meaning
walkthrough.index.description:
The project is indexed on this computer with a built-in model, nothing to install.
[Embedding settings](command:saturn.openAppSettings)
walkthrough.rules.title: Write project rules
walkthrough.rules.description:
Tell every agent how this project works in AGENTS.md.
[Edit Project Rules](command:saturn.editRules)
walkthrough.background.title: Run agents in the background
walkthrough.background.description:
Hand off a task to an agent on its own branch and keep working; Saturn tells you when it is done.
[Show Saturn Agents](command:saturn.runs.focus)
